description: Build-time ACP runtime base snapshot with selected upstream overlays; MIT license in LICENSE. No external checkout required.

overlays.adaptation: Crypto service calls retain the pinned Effect API. SelectProviderOptionDescriptor.role and sessionConfig reasoning role are cherry-picked from this revision.

localPatches: provider-acp initial activation owns native restoration once and tries the advertised alternate restoration method without creating a replacement session
contracts ProviderAuthMethod and registry auth retain normalized envVarNames and link metadata for generic env_var credential forms
provider-acp runtimeModel projects v2 state_update notifications to the host bridge
provider-core ProviderAuthFlow passes an optional forceReauthentication flag from the host to authentication without changing the default for existing callers
provider-acp-registry auth verifies an existing native session before ordinary login; only ACP auth-required permits interactive login; forced reauthentication remains explicit
provider-acp-registry auth projects the validated CodeBuddy private authUrl notification as a browser handoff, without opening it again or treating it as success
provider-acp runtime authenticate selects its protocol method lazily after initialize negotiates the ACP generation
